summary: First testing pass of Vendo (Expo/React Native + FastAPI + MongoDB). Backend and frontend both fully functional. 10/10 pytest backend tests pass. Full mobile UI flow verified: Home, Scan (sample→analyze→result→detail), Item Detail (strategy switching, sell-plan picker, publish), My Items (filter chips + rows), Profile (stats from /api/stats, toggles, sections), and bottom-tab navigation.

issues: Console warns about deprecated 'shadow*' style props and props.pointerEvents (React Native Web deprecation notices - non-blocking, cosmetic warnings only)

action_items: (Optional) Silence RN Web deprecation warnings by migrating shadow* styles to boxShadow and moving pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents.

(Optional) Scan flow creates a real DB item on every 'Analyser' tap in V1 (uses random catalog entry) — Profile 'EN ATTENTE' grew from 5→6 during test run. Confirm this is intended behaviour for V1 mock-AI.
(Optional) Add automatic teardown/cleanup of items created via scan during tests, or expose a 'test data' flag.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: db.items has no unique index on 'id'; not critical for V1 but recommended before scale.
server.py: `Item.strategies` uses List[PriceStrategy] without validating exactly 3 keys (fast/smart/max) — front-end assumes this shape.
server.py CORS uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True which browsers reject when actual credentials are sent; safe for current no-auth V1 but should be tightened when auth is added.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); FastAPI now recommends lifespan handlers.
server.py: PATCH ignores extra unknown fields silently — acceptable, but consider `model_config = {'extra': 'forbid'}` on ItemUpdate for stricter contract.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Backend `seed.py` already populated 5 items. One TEST_ item was created & deleted via pytest CRUD test. One additional draft item was inserted by the client-side scan flow during UI testing (V1 mock-AI behaviour) and left in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. All items exposed under /api/items with id (uuid). Key frontend testIDs: home-header, potential-amount, scan-primary-cta, scan-tab-cta, scan-sample-btn, analyze-btn, open-result-btn (NOT see-result-btn), detail-back, detail-delete, strategy-{fast,smart,max}, edit-listing-btn, plan-{quick,balanced,best}, publish-btn, filter-chip-{all,draft,ready,listed,sold}, item-row-{id}, stats-grid, stat-{earned,sold,avg,total,potential}, pref-{notifs,price}. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_vendo_api.py.
rca_of_issue: No blocking issues found. All V1 requirements from the review request verified working end-to-end: (1) GET /api/items returns seeded list, (2) GET /api/stats returns totals used by Home & Profile, (3) POST /api/items creates item with generated id, (4) GET /api/items/{id} returns 200 or 404 correctly, (5) PATCH updates listing/selected_strategy/sell_plan/status and persists, (6) DELETE removes and subsequent GET is 404. Frontend: Home shows greeting 'Bon après-midi Alex', potential total 11 330 €, 5 objets, +450 € gagnés, À optimiser list, Recent items; Scan idle→sample→preview→analyze→result→Voir le résultat navigates to /item/{id}; Detail hero + Sell Score ring + strategy cards dynamically update PRIX RECOMMANDÉ (fast=171€, smart=280€, max=326€ on AJ1 seed data), plan picker cycles quick/balanced/best, publish-btn present; My Items lists 6 items, all 5 filter chips present (all/draft/ready/listed/sold), rows tappable; Profile stats grid shows real values from /api/stats (450€ total gagné, 1 vendu, 450€ moyen, 6 en attente, 11 686€ potentiel), toggles + all sections render; 4 bottom tabs with prominent lime Scanner CTA.
